 If you are not instantly approved, we will mail you a credit decision within 5 to 7 business days. bonuses.requirements: Franklin Templeton Completes Final Regulatory Steps for Bitcoin Dividend ETFsHomeFeedNewsFranklin Templeton Completes Final Regulatory Steps for Bitcoin Dividend ETFsFranklin Templeton Completes Final Regulatory Steps for Bitcoin Dividend ETFs10/23 15:50Franklin Templeton, with assets under management of $1.7 trillion, has completed the final regulatory steps for the listing of two ETFs that convert stock dividends into Bitcoin. On October 22, the company submitted Form 8-A to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register shares of the Franklin US Equity Bitcoin DRIP Index ETF and the Franklin US Innovation Bitcoin DRIP Index ETF for trading on Nasdaq. The prospectus submitted on the same day indicates an effective date of October 27. These two funds were first filed in June of this year, without disclosing their codes or fees at that time. The stock fund is coded FBEQ and tracks the VettaFi US Large-Cap 500 Bitcoin DRIP Index, which is weighted by market capitalization and holds the 500 largest U.S. companies. As of September 30, it held 499 stocks, with a concentration in the information technology sector. The initial allocation for the fund is 95% stocks and 5% Bitcoin, with regular or special dividends from companies being used to purchase Bitcoin on the day after the ex-dividend date, increasing the Bitcoin allocation with each dividend. During quarterly rebalancing, any Bitcoin allocation exceeding 5% will be reduced to 4.5%; if the Bitcoin allocation exceeds 20% between two rebalancing periods, it will be reduced to 4.5% within two trading days, with the proceeds returning to stocks. The fund does not directly hold on-chain Bitcoin but gains exposure through Bitcoin exchange-traded products (including its own spot fund), futures and options, or depositary receipts, partly through a subsidiary in the Cayman Islands. $ADA ultimately closed the week above that level, with the chart showing the token reaching $0.248. This weekly close is notable because it shows that buyers managed to push $ADA through a price area that had previously rejected attempts to move higher.
